faqSection.title: Questions about Startup Fundraising on FundDreamz

faqs.question: Does my startup fundraiser need to reach its goal in order to receive the money I’ve raised?
faqs.answer: No, your startup can securely set up its bank transfer and start receiving funds within 3-5 days, regardless of whether your stated fundraising goal is fully met. This provides flexibility as your funding needs evolve.

faqs.question: What details should I include in my startup fundraiser on FundDreamz?
faqs.answer: You should include a detailed business plan, a clear articulation of your problem-solution, market analysis, financial projections, team profiles, and any existing traction or milestones achieved. A compelling video pitch and product demos are highly recommended.

faqs.question: How does FundDreamz help my startup connect with investors?
faqs.answer: FundDreamz provides a platform to showcase your startup to a broad audience, including potential angel investors and early-stage VCs. By sharing your unique fundraiser link, you can directly reach interested parties and manage all communications and updates through your dashboard.

faqs.question: How long will it take for my startup to receive the raised funds?
faqs.answer: Once your startup's bank account details are verified, funds are typically processed and transferred to your account within 3-5 business days, ensuring timely access to your capital.

faqs.question: Can I upload my pitch deck and business plan to my fundraiser?
faqs.answer: Yes, FundDreamz allows you to upload various documents, including your pitch deck, business plan, financial models, and any relevant legal documents, to provide comprehensive information to potential investors.

faqs.question: How much of the money raised will my startup keep?
faqs.answer: FundDreamz charges no platform fees for startup fundraisers, ensuring your startup retains more of the capital you raise to invest directly into your growth. Standard payment processing fees (typically around 2.9% + ₦0.30 per transaction) will be applied by our payment processor.

faqs.question: What kind of verification is needed for startup fundraisers?
faqs.answer: To ensure credibility and trust for investors, FundDreamz may require verification of your business registration, founder identities, and details of your startup's operational status. Transparency through regular project updates and financial reporting is also encouraged.

whyStartSection.title: Why start a Startup Fundraiser on FundDreamz?
whyStartSection.description: Launching a startup fundraiser on FundDreamz offers an innovative and accessible path to securing crucial capital at every stage of your journey. As a trusted community-powered fundraising platform, FundDreamz empowers entrepreneurs to connect directly with a diverse pool of potential investors, from friends and family to angel investors and venture capitalists. Whether you're seeking pre-seed capital for concept validation, seed funding for MVP development, or Series A for market expansion, FundDreamz provides user-friendly tools, secure processing, and a transparent environment to help your startup achieve its dreams and scale new heights.
